title: Ghost in the Shell
blurb: A cyborg officer questioning where her humanity ends, retold in four separate timelines: Oshii's films, Stand Alone Complex, the Arise prequels and a live-action remake.

groups.title: The Oshii films
groups.note: Mamoru Oshii's two films, one continuous story.

groups.title: Stand Alone Complex
groups.note: Films from the TV series' timeline. The two SAC_2045 films are cut-down versions of the Netflix series.

groups.title: Arise
groups.note: Concludes the Arise prequel series about the Major's early career.

note: None of the four timelines connect, so pick one. Oshii's 1995 film is the usual starting point. Solid State Society follows the second Stand Alone Complex series, and The New Movie follows the Arise episodes, so both make more sense after their series.
